candidatos.por_que: Amainar es lo que hace la tormenta cuando por fin se calma: eso le pasa a tu cortisol, a tu cara hinchada y a tu noche con cada sorbo.
Del colombianísimo 'bájale dos rayitas': la bebida que le baja el volumen al estrés antes de dormir.
Fusión de lullaby (canción de cuna) y lulo, la fruta colombiana: un arrullo nocturno con sabor de aquí.
candidatos.eslogan: Tu canción de cuna en vaso.

candidatos.por_que: Del japonés yuru, 'suelto, relajado, sin tensión', con sonido de palabra latina: aflojar la mandíbula, la cara y el día.
candidatos.eslogan: Afloja la cara, afloja el día.

candidatos.por_que: Lo que te decía tu mamá para calmarte, convertido en un ritual de cóctel nocturno para adultas cansadas.

verificacion: WebSearch '"Amaina" brand supplement OR skincare OR beauty': sin marca de suplementos ni belleza con ese nombre (solo parecidas: Amina's Natural Skincare, Aminnah, Amala). Libre para avanzar a búsqueda en SIC.
publico: Mujeres colombianas de 25 a 40 años, urbanas (Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla), profesionales, emprendedoras o mamás con agenda llena, estrato 3 a 6. Siguen el trend de 'cortisol face' y 'sleepy girl mocktail' en TikTok, se despiertan con la cara inflamada, duermen mal por estrés y gastan en wellness aspiracional (colágeno, magnesio, skincare coreano). Quieren un ritual bonito, no una pastilla.
inspiracion: Harmonia Cortisol Cocktail (el ritual de mocktail rosado para el cortisol) con la estética editorial de Rhode de Hailey Bieber: tonos lechosos, minimalismo cálido, nada de farmacia.
logo_en: All-lowercase wordmark 'amaina' set in Cormorant Garamond Light, slightly condensed tracking, with a custom calligraphic swash joining the final 'n' and 'a' like a slow exhale. Above the wordmark sits a small circular emblem: a thin half-sun rising over three horizontal wave lines that get progressively flatter and calmer from top to bottom (a storm settling into still water), drawn in a single 0.75 pt monoline stroke. The emblem doubles as a standalone monogram for stick packs and social avatars. Primary color deep storm indigo #2E2A4F on cream #FBF6F0; reversed version in cream on indigo. Feels like a boutique Parisian apothecary meets a calm Caribbean dawn.
envase_en: Cylindrical powder canister in seamless aluminum (8.5 cm diameter x 12 cm tall, 210 g / 30 servings) with a soft-touch matte lavender-mist powder coat #C9B8E0, a deep storm-indigo #2E2A4F anodized aluminum screw lid with fine vertical knurling and a debossed half-sun-over-waves emblem on top, foil induction seal inside and a translucent frosted scoop. Sold alongside a matching recyclable kraft-lined box of 14 single-serve stick packs (7 g each) in matte cream #FBF6F0 with the indigo emblem. The powder itself is a pale coral-pink (passion fruit and red berries flavor) that turns into a blush mocktail in water.
etiqueta_en: Printed directly on the canister in a vertical, airy layout with lots of negative space: top third holds the half-sun-over-waves emblem in iridescent pearl foil that shifts from lilac to peach, then the 'amaina' wordmark in deep indigo #2E2A4F blind-embossed so it can be felt. Middle: a thin peach #F4C7B5 hairline and the Spanish descriptor 'Cóctel cortisol · sin alcohol' in small caps, followed by 'Sabor maracuyá y frutos rojos' in italic serif. Bottom band: three minimal line icons with tiny captions 'Baja el cortisol', 'Desinflama', 'Duerme mejor', and the key actives 'Magnesio glicinato + B6 · B12 · C · D3 · Folato'. Fine print '30 porciones · 210 g' and 'Reg. INVIMA' tucked along the base. Back panel: nutrition table in a clean grid and the ritual instruction '1 scoop + 250 ml de agua fría, 30 min antes de dormir'. Finish: soft-touch matte with spot-gloss UV only on the wave lines, catching light like water.
escena_en: High-end campaign product photo: the amaina canister standing on a honed travertine plinth that rises out of a shallow pool of perfectly still water, with a few soft concentric ripples fading around its base. Beside it, a vintage crystal coupe glass filled with the blush coral-pink mocktail, one clear ice sphere, half a passion fruit with glossy seeds and a few fresh raspberries, plus a loose ribbon of lavender silk draped over the plinth edge. Background is a seamless gradient sky going from dusky lavender #C9B8E0 at the top to peach dawn #F4C7B5 near the horizon, with a faint layer of low mist. Lighting: soft diffused dawn light from the left, gentle rim light on the glass, delicate caustic reflections from the water on the travertine. Shot on medium format, 85 mm, f/5.6, calm, editorial, ultra clean.
lifestyle_en: TikTok/Instagram vertical shot, iPhone look, in a Bogotá apartment in Chapinero Alto at dusk on a rainy evening: raindrops streaking the big window with blurred city lights and the green Cerros Orientales behind. A woman's hand with a neutral almond manicure and a thin gold ring stirs the blush coral-pink mocktail in a coupe glass with a long gold spoon; no face shown, only her forearm in an oversized cream knit sweater. The amaina canister sits on a light oak side table next to a beeswax candle, a phone face down and a folded wool ruana. Warm tungsten lamp light inside contrasting with the cool blue rain outside, cozy 'the storm is outside, not inside me' mood, slight film grain.

candidatos.por_que: En Colombia 'sin afán' es sin prisa: el hombre que tiene energía y aguante de sobra para tomarse todo su tiempo.
candidatos.eslogan: Lo bueno se hace sin afán.
candidatos.tono: lujo relajado, seguro, con picardía elegante

candidatos.por_que: Del latín durare, 'resistir', y del español 'duraré': una promesa entera en una sola palabra.
Fusión de maca y tongkat ali, las dos raíces estrella de la fórmula, con sonido de isla y aventura.
Lo que se pide cuando la noche está buena y todavía queda energía para más.
candidatos.eslogan: Ella pide otra ronda. Tú cumples.

candidatos.por_que: En italiano 'ancora' significa 'otra vez'; en español, áncora es ancla: firmeza que se repite.

verificacion: WebSearch '"Sin Afán" marca suplemento OR suplementos OR cosmética': no aparece ninguna marca de suplementos ni cosmética con ese nombre. Libre para avanzar a búsqueda en SIC (clase 5).
publico: Hombres colombianos de 30 a 55 años, profesionales, independientes o empresarios, con pareja, que van al gimnasio o juegan fútbol los fines de semana. Notan bajón de energía, libido y aguante por estrés y edad, compran por TikTok, Instagram y WhatsApp, y quieren algo discreto y premium que puedan dejar en la mesa de noche sin pena, no un frasco vulgar de 'potenciador' de farmacia de esquina.
inspiracion: Casamigos de George Clooney (lujo relajado de hombre seguro que no tiene que demostrar nada) con la discreción clínica y el tono adulto de Hims.
logo_en: Uppercase wordmark 'SIN AFÁN' in DM Serif Display with generous letter-spacing (+120), the acute accent over the second 'Á' replaced by a tiny brass diamond. The symbol is an hourglass turned on its side so it reads as an infinity sign: two soft teardrop bulbs joined at a narrow waist, drawn in a single 1 pt brushed-brass line with a few grains of 'sand' resting still in both halves, meaning time has stopped. The symbol sits centered above the wordmark inside a thin circular seal with the micro-text 'FÓRMULA DE VIGOR · BOGOTÁ' running around the edge. Primary version brushed brass #B08D57 on espresso black #1F1A17; secondary in espresso on bone #EDE6DA. Feels like a mezcal or a bespoke tailor label, never like a pharmacy.
envase_en: Squat, heavy wide-mouth glass jar (200 ml, 60 capsules) in opaque matte espresso-black glass #1F1A17 with a thick base, topped by a solid brushed-brass finish aluminum screw cap #B08D57 with the sideways-hourglass symbol debossed on top and a fine knurled edge. Capsules are dark tobacco-brown vegetable capsules (shilajit, maca, tongkat ali, turkesterone, ashwagandha, ginseng). Foil induction seal under the cap. Comes in a rigid two-piece gift-style box in espresso black with a terracotta #8C3B2A inner lining and a magnetic closure so it can be shipped and gifted discreetly.
etiqueta_en: Wrap-around label on textured uncoated bone paper #EDE6DA, letterpress-printed with a subtle deboss. Hierarchy: the circular seal with the sideways-hourglass symbol in brushed brass hot foil at the top, the 'SIN AFÁN' wordmark large in espresso black below it, then a thin terracotta #8C3B2A rule and the discreet Spanish descriptor 'Vigor y testosterona natural · Para él'. Middle row: six ingredient names in small caps separated by brass dots 'MACA · TONGKAT ALI · SHILAJIT · TURKESTERONA · ASHWAGANDHA · GINSENG'. Bottom: '60 cápsulas' and a hand-stamped look batch field 'Lote Nº ___' in terracotta ink, plus 'Reg. INVIMA' in tiny type. Back: dosage 'Toma 2 cápsulas al día. Sin afán.' Finishes: brass foil, blind deboss on the wordmark, deckled edge on the right side of the label, a thin terracotta tamper strip over the cap.
escena_en: Dark, moody luxury campaign shot in chiaroscuro: the SIN AFÁN jar on a slab of raw black volcanic basalt with natural texture, set on a cognac leather surface. Props arranged with restraint: a vintage brass hourglass lying on its side, a small chunk of glossy raw shilajit resin, a few dried yellow maca roots, splintered tongkat ali root chips in a hand-carved wooden bowl, and a heavy crystal rocks glass of sparkling water with a lime twist and one large clear ice cube. Background a deep espresso-to-black gradient with faint warm haze. Lighting: single warm amber key light raking from the right like late-evening sun, a soft brass-colored rim light outlining the jar and cap, deep shadows on the left, small specular highlights on the foil. Shot on medium format, 100 mm, f/8, rich and tactile.
lifestyle_en: Instagram/TikTok vertical shot, iPhone look, in a colonial boutique hotel room in Cartagena's Walled City at blue hour: tall wooden shutters half open to a balcony with bougainvillea, a slowly spinning wooden ceiling fan, white linen sheets slightly undone. A man's hand with a classic steel watch and a rolled-up white linen shirt sleeve unscrews the brass cap of the SIN AFÁN jar on a dark wooden nightstand, next to a pair of sunglasses, a hotel key with a tassel and two glasses of water. No face shown; in the soft background out of focus, a woman's bare shoulder and a silk robe hint at the plan for the night. Warm lamp light mixing with the cool blue evening outside, relaxed, unhurried mood, slight film grain.
